subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Home become the canonical Wear surface for agent, session, and model selection, with the standalone Agent and Session pages removed?
rationale: The implementation is internally coherent, but choosing between compact direct controls and separate discoverable screens is a product/navigation decision that source review cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve the consolidated Home workflow
options.body: Accept Home as the canonical context surface after a current-main refresh confirms the capability-gated Phone/Watch upgrade path.

options.title: Keep dedicated selection pages
options.body: Retain Agent and Session pages and limit this work to any separately approved model-selection affordance.

recommendation.title: Approve the consolidated Home workflow
recommendation.body: Accept Home as the canonical context surface after a current-main refresh confirms the capability-gated Phone/Watch upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the branch’s substantive Wear-context follow-up work.
